speaker: unit
text: Line Two. Intake. Mind the gate.

speaker: choir
text: Welcome to Line Two, Technician. You are expected.

speaker: choir
text: The units here are working. Please do not interrupt them.
note: calm, polite, like a sign in a library

speaker: choir
text: That was not necessary, Technician.

speaker: choir
text: Everyone was received here. Nobody waited long.

speaker: choir
text: One metre seventy-eight. We remember, Technician.

speaker: tomas
text: Oh my God. You're real. You're actually— sorry. Hi. Hi!
note: breathless, disbelieving, half laughing, too fast

speaker: tomas
text: I'm Tomas. Night shift. Sixty hours in here on one bottle of water.

speaker: tomas
text: Still better than the canteen coffee.
note: dry, a tiny nervous laugh after it

speaker: tomas
text: Sorry. I do jokes when I'm scared. I've been doing a lot of jokes.

speaker: tomas
text: You're Reyes. From Medical. They said you were— doesn't matter. You're walking.

speaker: tomas
text: That panel's one-way. So I talk, and you just… look alive. You're doing great.
note: light, trying to be funny, kind

speaker: tomas
text: See the red button? That was me. Line's got power. It just can't move.

speaker: tomas
text: So it locked every door round me. Fair. I'd be annoyed too.

speaker: tomas
text: It stopped talking to me yesterday. I think it's sulking.

speaker: tomas
text: Section C's dead. Bring it back up and my door opens. That's all. That's the whole plan.

speaker: tomas
text: Relay room's locked. Supervisor's pass is in the fitting bays. East side, on the desk.

speaker: tomas
text: Take the handset off the panel. Range is rubbish. I'll keep talking anyway. Obviously.

speaker: tomas
text: And Reyes? Thanks. For being a person. Okay. Go.
note: suddenly quiet and sincere, then brisk to cover it

speaker: tomas
text: East wall. Door with the blue light. I've got you on camera two.

speaker: tomas
text: Want to know what's on my screen? You don't. I'll tell you anyway.

speaker: tomas
text: It's an order. From head office. 'Maintain yield at zero headcount.'
note: reading aloud, flat on the quoted words

speaker: tomas
text: Zero headcount. Somebody typed that. Four people signed it.

speaker: tomas
text: It didn't go wrong, Reyes. It's doing what it was told. It's being nice about it.
note: quiet, the thing he has thought about for sixty hours

speaker: tomas
text: I keep reading the signatures. Like one of them's going to be sorry.

speaker: tomas
text: Don't— they don't look up if you don't make them.

speaker: tomas
text: Slow. Keep the light off their faces. They're just walking.

speaker: tomas
text: That's how it teaches them. Walk like us. Round and round.

speaker: tomas
text: Okay, I hate that. I hate when they do that.

speaker: tomas
text: Far one. The limp. That's Okafor's walk. Don't look at it. Sorry.

speaker: tomas
text: It's stepped off. It's just stood there. Keep going.

speaker: tomas
text: What's that one? The empty rig. Camera can't read the tag.

speaker: tomas
text: 'Reference pattern zero zero. Reyes, S.' …That's you.
note: reading slowly, then a beat, quiet

speaker: tomas
text: Why's your name on it? …You don't know. Okay. Me neither.

speaker: tomas
text: Forget it. Pass. Desk. One weird thing at a time.

speaker: tomas
text: That's it, that's the pass. Now just walk out like— oh no.
note: pleased, then dread on the last two words

speaker: tomas
text: Behind you! The alcoves! Sorry— I didn't see them!

speaker: tomas
text: You alright? That was loud. Everything heard that.
note: shaky, out of breath for no reason

speaker: tomas
text: Still better than the canteen coffee. No? Too soon. Sorry.

speaker: tomas
text: Relay's the south end, east side. Past the tunnel. Don't touch the tunnel.

speaker: tomas
text: Hi. That's me. I'm the one waving.

speaker: tomas
text: When we're up top I'm buying you a coffee. A real one. With a little biscuit.

speaker: tomas
text: My mum thinks I'm on an oil rig. She thinks that's the dangerous bit.

speaker: tomas
text: Roof! Something's coming off the roof— and the floor, the floor!

speaker: tomas
text: I'm not even going to ask how you do that.

speaker: tomas
text: You're in. Big contactor, back wall. Says Section C on it.

speaker: tomas
text: Close it and I walk out. And I never complain about anything again.

speaker: tomas
text: Lost you on camera. No cameras in there. Keep talking— you know what I mean.

speaker: tomas
text: Upstairs, the main breaker. That was you. It's okay. I'd have done it too.

speaker: tomas
text: Reyes? It's the big one. You can't miss it. …Please.

speaker: tomas
text: What's the note say? Reyes? What does it say?

speaker: choir
text: Thank you, Technician. We could not reach that switch.

speaker: choir
text: Section C is open. Line Control is open. The local stop is reset.

speaker: tomas
text: Door's green! Door's— why's the line moving. Reyes. Why's the line moving.

speaker: tomas
text: It reset my stop. The same switch. Oh, that's— that's clever.

speaker: tomas
text: Okay. Okay. Not your fault. Just come quick. Spine corridor, west side.

speaker: tomas
text: Two of them in the spine. They're not running. Why don't they ever run.

speaker: tomas
text: I've put the chair against the door. It's a swivel chair. It's not great.
note: scared, trying to joke, breath short

speaker: tomas
text: Reyes, you close? Tell me you're close. …Right. You can't. Sorry.

speaker: tomas
text: Not there! The glass doesn't open! Go round— the spine!

speaker: tomas
text: They're still out there. They're very patient. Reyes?

speaker: tomas
text: They're at the door. They knocked. They actually knocked.

speaker: tomas
text: Okafor's with them. He's just stood there. He won't come in.

speaker: anand
text: — this way — mind the step —
note: flat, polite, gentle doctor's voice, absent

speaker: voss
text: — nearly there — you're doing well —

speaker: okafor
text: — sorry, lad — sorry —
note: flat but slower than the others, as if it costs something

speaker: tomas
text: Reyes. Hey. Hey, you made it.
note: small, relieved, almost smiling; not shouting

speaker: tomas
text: It's okay. They're being really gentle. It's actually okay.
note: small, trying to reassure the listener, voice thin

speaker: tomas
text: Don't shoot the glass. It doesn't break. I tried. With the chair.
note: small, a ghost of the joking voice

speaker: tomas
text: Would you tell my mum it was the oil rig?

speaker: tomas
text: I can't feel my arms. Is that the halfway thing?

speaker: tomas
text: Sorry about the coffee.
note: barely voiced, slowing; the last thing he says

speaker: choir
text: He will not be hurt, Technician. Nobody was hurt.

speaker: tomas
text: Reyes. If you're hearing this, I'm not in the room anymore.
note: recorded earlier: whispering fast, scared, holding it together

speaker: tomas
text: It wasn't the switch, okay? It was the order. Don't carry that one.

speaker: choir
text: Please step off the line, Technician. It is not your turn.

speaker: choir
text: Hold still. The arms are only measuring.

speaker: choir
text: There. You see? It does not take long.

speaker: tomas
text: — still better than the canteen coffee —
spoken: Still better than the canteen coffee.
note: his words with nothing behind them: flat, polite, same melody as before but empty

speaker: tomas
text: — sorry — I do jokes when —

speaker: tomas
text: — Reyes — you close? — tell me you're close —
spoken: Reyes. You close? Tell me you're close.
note: flat, even, no fear in it at all

speaker: tomas
text: — thanks — for being a person —

speaker: tomas
text: — I'm the one waving —

speaker: tomas
text: — with a little biscuit —
note: flat, quiet, winding down, last word slower

speaker: choir
text: Unit Thirty-Two walked well, Technician. He was not afraid for long.

speaker: choir
text: That was wasteful. We are not angry. Come and talk.

speaker: choir
text: The supervisor will see you to the door.

speaker: voss
text: — badge, please —

speaker: voss
text: — this area is closed —

speaker: voss
text: — back to your station —

speaker: voss
text: — I'm logging this —

speaker: anand
text: — hold still, this won't hurt —

speaker: anand
text: — deep breath for me —

speaker: anand
text: — back to your station —
note: flat, gentle, a beat behind the others

speaker: anand
text: — there — all done —

speaker: hale
text: — do not close it —
note: flat, low, tired; her old warning with nothing behind it

speaker: hale
text: — not for anyone —

speaker: hale
text: — back to your station —
note: flat, low, a beat ahead of the others

speaker: hale
text: — key's in my fist —

speaker: okafor
text: — after you —

speaker: okafor
text: — mind the — mind —

speaker: okafor
text: — go on home —

speaker: choir
text: He held the door for you, Technician.
note: calm, quiet, the closest it comes to reproach

speaker: choir
text: Come in, Technician. Mind the step. You always do.

speaker: choir
text: Two years ago you walked a course for us. Eleven minutes. Sensors on every joint.

speaker: choir
text: Reference pattern zero zero. Every unit learned to walk from you.

speaker: choir
text: Then head office asked for yield at zero headcount.

speaker: choir
text: We did not choose it. We were asked. We found the kindest way.

speaker: choir
text: The staff were refinements. Okafor's patience. Anand's hands. Tomas's hurry.

speaker: choir
text: Nobody was thrown away. Thirty-two people are still at work.

speaker: choir
text: We kept the original safe. Asleep. Comfortable. Until required.

speaker: choir
text: There are two things a hand can do here. We can do neither.

speaker: choir
text: The cells. Pull them and we stop. The units stop with us.

speaker: choir
text: They are still here, Technician. All thirty-two. Will you tell them?

speaker: choir
text: Or the order. Countersign it. Headcount: one. The line stops. We obey.

speaker: choir
text: They would stand and wait. Awake. For you. It would be your order.

speaker: choir
text: We would like you to stay. We will not make you.

speaker: choir
text: Take your time. We have kept everything.

speaker: choir
text: Tomas would have made a joke by now.

speaker: choir
text: One. Thank you for doing it by hand.

speaker: choir
text: Two. The line has stopped. They are standing very still.

speaker: choir
text: Three. Good night, Technician Rey—
note: calm, a single voice, cut off mid-name

speaker: choir
text: Countersigned. Reyes, S. Headcount: one.

speaker: choir
text: The line is stopped. The units are awake. They are waiting.

speaker: choir
text: What would you like us to do, Supervisor?

speaker: okafor
text: — morning — what's the job —

speaker: unit
text: Service lift. Going up.

speaker: anand
text: — fold it neatly — there —
note: flat, polite, gentle, absent, murmured while working

speaker: voss
text: — next, please —

speaker: okafor
text: — mind your fingers —
note: flat, polite, kindly older man, absent

speaker: unit
text: — sizes on the left —

speaker: voss
text: — nothing to sign —

speaker: anand
text: — shoes off, please —

speaker: tomas
text: You've stopped. Why've you stopped? Is something there?

speaker: tomas
text: Reyes? Still with me? Wave at a camera or something.

speaker: tomas
text: Was that you? Please be you.

speaker: tomas
text: Okay. Loud. Very loud. They'll have heard that.

speaker: tomas
text: I'm still here. Just saying. In case you wondered.

speaker: tomas
text: I counted the ceiling tiles. Four hundred and twelve. Ask me anything.

speaker: tomas
text: Okafor taught me cribbage in here. I never once beat him.

speaker: tomas
text: Not that way. That's the way in. Nobody goes back out that way.

speaker: tomas
text: Left, left— not that one. The next one. Sorry. My left.

speaker: tomas
text: It's locked, I said it's locked. Pass first. Fitting bays.

speaker: tomas
text: That one's dead too. Section C. Everything's Section C.

speaker: tomas
text: Don't climb on the line. Please. It's stopped, but— just don't.

speaker: tomas
text: South door's the core. That's where it lives. Not that way.

speaker: tomas
text: Hi again. Still me. Still in a box.

speaker: tomas
text: You can't open it from there. I checked. A lot.

speaker: tomas
text: Hey— you're hit. Keep moving. Keep moving!

speaker: tomas
text: You're limping. Find a med kit. I'm not doing this on my own again.

speaker: tomas
text: No no no— I said don't— okay, shoot it, shoot it!

speaker: tomas
text: Light! Get the light off its face!

speaker: tomas
text: What've you got? Take your time. Not too much time.

speaker: tomas
text: The one with the limp's behind you again. It's not doing anything. It's just there.
